# kcore hypervisor

> Declarative virtualization on NixOS, version 0.7.0: HA restart, live migration, Ceph shared storage, canary updates with automatic revert, a dashboard, a Terraform provider, an MCP server and AI agent shipped with the product (not hosted on this domain). Two separate paid products: kcore Vault (immutable backups) and kcore Provisioning (bare-metal automation through the BMC).

## API note

Management plane is gRPC to your controller, not public REST on kcorehypervisor.com. See the repo for `.proto` and design docs.
